text: PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 1 : 69 of Block 12, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 110197, situated in the Village of Echchankulama within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 279 - Mahakalattewa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Nuwaragam Palatha East, in the District of Anuradhapura, in the Province of North Central, referred to in Notice No. 11/0502 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2381/02 of 22nd April, 2024 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, Np. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Mfeura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 06th January, 2025.
(Published by Authority)
